verdict.rationale: Mailchimp's developer platform offers Mailchimp Transactional (formerly Mandrill) for event-driven messages via API or SMTP, next to the Marketing API for campaigns. Transactional also has its own message-event webhooks (send, delivered, bounce, open, click), so developers can send one-to-one email through the same vendor. A community comment notes Mandrill was still not well integrated with Mailchimp years after the merger, which suggests a separate API surface rather than one unified API, but it does not contradict that transactional sending works. Missing for 10: an explicit first-party transactional email send endpoint (only the SMS send call is cited), documented use cases like receipts or magic links, evidence of unified account/API integration with marketing sends, and independent hands-on corroboration.
